metadata.time_note: Storm Data entry times should be reviewed in local Standard Time (ST), not daylight time. Candidate reports include standard_time_display.
metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

candidate_reports.remark: Broadcast Media relayed a report and photo of several powerlines down on Watson Lane West between Interstate 35 and Farm to Market Road 1102. Time estimated by radar.
Report from mPING. Quarter sized hail.
AWOS station KHYI San Marcos Regional Arpt.
Stalled vehicle reported on Alamo and Probandt.
High-water rescue just after 7 AM involving a man carried 100 ft downstream by floodwaters to near San Pedro Ave and Basse Rd.
Lockhill Selma at Gardenview closed due to water over the road.
Several downed tree limbs 3 inches in diameter or larger_ and minor structural damage within town. Several thousand were without power across Del Rio. Time estimated via radar.
ASOS station KDRT Del Rio Intl Airport.
FM 243 closed due to water on roadway east of Mahomet in Burnet County. Additional reports that CR 214_ CR 213 and CR 212 have water on road and are barely passable.
Social media picture of the intersection of CR 201 and CR 206 flooded with a few feet of water and still rising.
Social media video of fast moving water closing Crockett and Bowie Street in Hallettsville between North La Grange Street and North Texana Street in Hallettsville.
Several roads in the Andice area with water over the roadway_ including CR 241_ CR245_ and CR208.
flooding ongoing with high water on CR 128 and Edna Street.
flooding ongoing with high water near CR 198 and FM 957.
Social media video of fast moving current of flood waters advancing through property from runoff; entering animal structures and low-lying locations.
Video of flooding and very fast moving current from Bloody Hollow Creek near the Grand Mesa at Crystal Falls neighborhood. Time estimated.
Several low water crossings of the North Fork San Gabriel River closed to the north of Liberty Hill. This included the 700 block of CR 257 and CR 258.
low water crossing closed at Mill Creek near Briggs with a few feet of flowing water across the road.
CR 279 Flooded and bridge being closed at Jinks Branch.
Low water crossings on Nameless Road along Big Sandy Creek in NW Travis County being barricaded off due to flooding.
Flash flooding associated with Block House Creek at Peggy Garner Park. 3 to 4 feet depth of flowing water on roadside flood gauge across Peach Tree Lane.
Downed powerlines in the Deer Run area and up to 1800 people were without power. Time estimated via radar.
Leander Road (RM 2243) closed due to flooding. Several low water crossings across Williamson county closed.
Numerous low water crossings closed Travis County to north and northwest of Austin; including the usual Spicewood road crossings.
Several low water crossings closed in southeastern Llano County near Horseshoe Bay.
Several low water crossings closed in southern Burnet county near Marble Falls.
Flooding of the low water crossings with 3 feet of flowing water in Johnson City.
Several low water crossings closed across Travis County; especially North Austin.
Just under 2 dozen low water crossings closed within City of Austin. Shoal Creek at 12 street had risen to a crest near 9 feet.
Ongoing water rescue at the low water crossing on Slaughter Creek at Old San Antonio Road in Travis County.
Vehicle swept away at 1500 Block Lower Mason Creek Road; Vehicle moving down stream.
*** 1 FATAL *** A vehicle traveling along Lower Mason Creek Road was swept away by flash flooding into Mason Creek. One victim was recovered inside the vehicle roughly two miles downstream.
Road closed and Vehicle trapped at low water crossing; Wasp Creek on RM 1376.
Water rescues at 100 block of CR 472 in Coupland.
Street flooding with pooling water on roadways due to heavy rain.
Common low water crossings closed due to flooding in Boerne area; one stalled vehicle at a low water crossing.
Vehicle in water at low water crossing of Red Bluff creek near Pipe Creek.
Several vehicles trapped by floodwaters and FD conducting home evacuations across the city.
Corrects previous flash flood report from 1 ENE Castle Hills. Several low water crossings closed; currently focused in the north-northwestern half of the county.
Several low water crossings closed; currently focused in the north-northeastern half of the county.
Trained spotter reported water across all 4 lanes of US90 at Cupples Rd.
Numerous stranded vehicles and water rescues ongoing in NW side of San Antonio.
Widespread inundation across El Indio Highway observed via video on social media_ likely several inches in depth.
FM 1376 at Wasp Creek had pavement wash out due to flooding. Road remains closed.
Above 35 low water crossings now closed due to flooding across Bexar County and San Antonio metro area.
Spicewood Springs Road impassable due to flood waters along with a large log blocking the road.
Road Closures across Johnson City due to flooding.
Round Closures in Round Mountain on 962 E and W.
Delayed report. Water rescue near Lombrano St at Colorado St involving person stranded in vehicle in floodwaters.
Road closures reported at 29900 blk Bulverde Ln near Indian Creek_ Obst Road at Leroy Scheel Rd near Cibolo Creek_ and Old Bastrop Rd at York Creek.
14 low water crossings closed or in close monitoring mainly in the eastern portion of the county.
Two stranded cars in flood waters at SE Military Drive and S New Braunfels Avenue near Brooks. Water depth of 2 to 3 feet. Time estimated.
FM 1021 closed due to flooding via TxDOT; a video on social media indicates considerable flooding over a large section of the road.
8.85 inches of rain measured at the Cinco Ranch TWDB site (TW120) between 0605am and 0105 pm.
Road closures in the City of Bandera at 1100 block of Hackberry_ btwn Main St and 11th St_ also on Maple St between Main St and 14th St.
Flowing water at low water crossing on FM 1283 at PR 37. Road closed.
Park Road 37 between 18th St and 21st St 6 to 8 inches of water over the roadway. Park Road 37 at 30th St_ report of 1 of water over the road.
Photos of a downed tree and large tree limbs in Leon Valley. Time estimated via radar.
11300 Block FM1283_ btwn Pebble Beach Dr and Odoms Rd_ reported 3 of water over the road. Roadway is closed at this time.
Report from mPING Street/road flooding Street/road closed Vehicles stranded.
One submerged car and another stuck at the low water crossing FM 1283 at Odom Rd near Pebble Beach Road.
Report from mPING Street/road flooding; Street/road closed; Vehicles stranded.
Numerous low water crossings closed between Helotes and Cross Mountain.
Report from mPING Street/road flooding Street/road closed Vehicles stranded.
Several low water crossings closed across San Antonio and Bexar County.
Multiple water rescues occurred at FM 471 N at San Geronimo Creek. Time estimated.
Corrects previous flash flood report from 1 S Rio Medina. Multiple water rescues occurred at FM 471 N at San Geronimo Creek. Time estimated.
Pictures of low crossing of Leon Creek with few feet of flowing water at State Highway 151 and Pinn Road. Time estimated.
Stalled car in low water crossing of Leon Creek at West Commerce Street. Time estimated.
